title: An unguarded reading can alias compliant and noncompliant states
statement: Actual one-axis errors 2.95 and 3.05 mm with allowed sensor errors +.05 and -.05 mm both read 3.00 mm. Better observations or an independent physical bound can resolve this. Separate introduced differential expansion 11 ppm/K across 14 mm and 2 K gives .308 um and .103796 mm extra bound, totaling 3.015288 mm only if genuinely differential and uncancelled. This is not a measured thermal failure.
